_comment: Gates in `check:static` that the CI static-gates job does NOT run. Only live-store or machine-observation checks belong here: anything reproducible from a clean checkout runs in CI. Each entry names why CI cannot read its input, an owner, and `runPoint`, the operation it protects (it still runs there). tests/check-static-ci-parity.test.mjs fails when a gate is in neither list, an entry is not in `check:static`, or a field is empty.

arch:coverage-gate.reason: Reads .audit-loop/domain-deps-observed.json, the observed import graph that arch:refresh/arch:render derive from the cloud symbol store (embeddings + import rows); gitignored, machine-observation, not reproducible from a clean checkout. With ARCH_COVERAGE_REQUIRE_ENVELOPE=1 it would fail every PR; without it, it exits 0 having read nothing. The committed-source layering invariant is covered in CI by tests/arm-vocabulary-layering.test.mjs (npm test, full-suite).
arch:coverage-gate.runPoint: pre-push hook (guards the push of main-bound commits against observed layering drift)

upstream:reconcile:gate.reason: Live-store: reconciles the upstream-issue ledger against the cloud audit store and a per-store ledger identity. CI has no store DSN (public repo, no secrets) and a store read there would be someone else's store, so it cannot measure.
upstream:reconcile:gate.runPoint: pre-push hook (guards pushing a ledger that diverges from the shared store)
